title: GCP Cloud Engineer
description: Design and deploy data-intensive and containerized solutions on Google Cloud Platform using Compute Engine, Cloud Run, GKE, and BigQuery.

goal.objective: Deploy and scale modern cloud-native applications on Google Cloud Platform, leveraging Google’s advanced networking and data analytics capabilities.

learn.summary: Master GCP global VPC networking, IAM permissions and service accounts, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run serverless containers, Cloud Storage, and BigQuery.
key_competencies: GCP Global VPC Networks & Cloud Load Balancing
Cloud IAM Roles, Service Accounts & Workload Identity

capstone_projects.title: Production Microservice Fleet on Cloud Run & GKE
capstone_projects.description: Deploy an automated microservices pipeline using Cloud Build, Cloud Run autoscaling, and Cloud SQL with Private Service Access.

capstone_projects.title: Serverless Event Pipeline with GCP Cloud Run & Pub/Sub
capstone_projects.description: Architect a zero-maintenance serverless ingestion pipeline processing millions of events per day into BigQuery using Terraform for immutable infrastructure.

interview_focus: Google Cloud Global VPC Subnets vs Regional AWS VPCs
Cloud Run vs GKE Selection Criteria
Cloud Load Balancing (HTTP(S) Proxy vs Network LB)

tree.name: Foundations and Cloud Fundamentals
tree.description: Establish an unshakeable Google Cloud Platform foundation: resource hierarchy architecture, global infrastructure backbone, and administrative automation via the `gcloud` CLI and Google Cloud SDK.

resources.title: Google Cloud Full Course for Beginners [2025] | GCP Tutorial with Hands-On Labs | GCP Crash Course (Tech Tutorials with Piyush)

children.name: Cloud Computing Essentials
children.description: Master cloud architectural fundamentals from a Google Cloud perspective: comparing IaaS, PaaS, and serverless runtimes; evaluating Capex vs Opex financial modeling; understanding Google's private software-defined global fiber network (Jupiter, Andromeda); and designing for high availability and low latency.

resources.title: Google Cloud for DevOps Engineers - Free Course (Google Cloud Skills Boost)
Cloud Computing In 6 Minutes | What Is Cloud Computing? | Cloud Computing Explained | Simplilearn (Simplilearn)
Tutorial 1- Deployment of Models- Premises VS IAAS vs PAAS cloud Platforms

children.name: GCP Global Infrastructure and Resource Hierarchy
children.description: Master Google Cloud resource hierarchy and governance: Organization node, Folders (departmental/environment segmentation), Projects (resource boundaries, billing attachment, API enablement), Organization Policy Service (enforcing domain-restricted sharing, disabling external IP allocation, disabling service account key creation), and Cloud Billing Accounts.

resources.title: EP 3. GCP Resource Hierarchy 🚀 Organizations Projects and Folders
GCP RESOURCE HIERARCHY | How to Design Your Resource Hierarchy | Google Cloud | Cloud Career

children.name: Developer Tools: Cloud Console, gcloud CLI, and Cloud Shell
children.description: Master Google Cloud developer tooling and automation: configuring `gcloud` CLI configurations and components, parsing output using formatting filters (`--filter`, `--format='json'`), managing credentials, and developing automation scripts using Google Cloud Client Libraries in Python and Go.

resources.title: GCP Essentials - Google Cloud Platform Tutorial for Beginners

tree.name: Core GCP Services: Compute, Networking, Storage, and Identity
tree.description: Master core Google Cloud infrastructure: identity and access management, global VPC networking, Compute Engine, Cloud Run serverless containers, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), and scalable cloud storage.

children.name: Identity and Access Management (IAM)
children.description: Master Cloud IAM (Identity and Access Management): principle of least privilege, Member types (users, Google Groups, Service Accounts), predefined vs custom roles, IAM Conditions (`request.time`, `resource.name`), Workload Identity Federation (authenticating AWS/GitHub Actions without long-lived service account keys), and Service Account impersonation.

resources.title: Google Cloud IAM Explained Simply (IAM in GCP)
IAM Explained in Google Cloud: Manage Access and Permissions

children.name: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) Networking Fundamentals
children.description: Architect global Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs): global VPC networks, regional subnets, firewall rules (ingress/egress priority, target tags, service account filtering), Cloud NAT for private instance outbound internet, and Cloud DNS for internal and public resolution.

resources.title: Google Cloud Networking Fundamentals (Google Cloud Tech)
Google Cloud Networking Tutorial - Step by Step Guide

children.name: Advanced Network Services and Connectivity
children.description: Master enterprise network architectures: Shared VPC (host project sharing subnets with service projects), VPC Network Peering, Cloud Router with BGP routing, Cloud Interconnect / Partner Interconnect, and Private Service Connect (PSC) for accessing Google and third-party services securely.

resources.title: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Networking Full Course for Beginners
GCP Security Services | Cloud Security Command Center | GCP Training | Edureka Rewind

children.name: Compute Engine: Virtual Machines and Instance Groups
children.description: Master Compute Engine infrastructure: machine families (General-purpose E2/N2, Compute-optimized C2, Memory-optimized M2), live migration capabilities, preemptible and Spot VMs for 60-91% cost savings, Managed Instance Groups (MIGs) with stateful configurations and autoscaling policies, and Shielded VMs.

resources.title: Getting Started with Google Compute Engine (Tech Primers)
GCP Managed Instance Groups - AutoScaling, AutoHealing, Rolling Update!

children.name: Serverless Platforms (Cloud Run, Functions, App Engine)
children.description: Deploy scalable serverless applications: Cloud Run (container-to-production in seconds, concurrency tuning per container instance, min/max instances, serverless VPC access connectors, and traffic splitting for canary deployments), and event-driven Cloud Functions (2nd gen on Cloud Run).

resources.title: Google Cloud Run Tutorial for Beginners
Serverless with Google Cloud Functions for Beginners

children.name: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
children.description: Master Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE): GKE Autopilot (fully managed control plane and node infrastructure) vs GKE Standard, VPC-native clusters with alias IP routing, GKE Workload Identity, cluster autoscaler, node auto-provisioning, and Binary Authorization for supply-chain security.

resources.title: Kubernetes Course - Full Crash Course for Beginners

children.name: Storage Solutions: Object, Block, and File
children.description: Engineer object and file storage: Cloud Storage (Standard, Nearline, Coldline, Archive tiers), Object Lifecycle Management rules, Uniform bucket-level access, Object Versioning, Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK), signed URLs, and Filestore for NFS shared file storage.

resources.title: Google Cloud Storage: A Complete Tutorial

children.name: Database Services: Relational and NoSQL
children.description: Deploy resilient Google Cloud databases: Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL with automated failover and read replicas), Cloud Spanner (globally distributed relational database with external consistency and the TrueTime API), and Cloud Bigtable for ultra-low latency NoSQL workloads.

resources.title: Choosing a Database for Google Cloud
SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners

children.name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform and Deployment Manager
children.description: Automate cloud deployments with HashiCorp Terraform: Google provider (`google` / `google-beta`), remote state backend in Cloud Storage with object versioning, writing modular Terraform configurations, and validating policies with Google Cloud Asset Inventory.

resources.title: Manage your infrastructure as code on Google Cloud (Google Cloud Blog)
Learn Terraform with Google Cloud Platform – Infrastructure as Code Course

children.name: CI/CD Pipelines with Cloud Build and Artifact Registry
children.description: Build enterprise CI/CD pipelines: Cloud Build for container image compilation, Artifact Registry for Docker/OCI artifacts, and Google Cloud Deploy for declarative continuous delivery to GKE and Cloud Run with automated promotion and rollback.

resources.title: Deploying to Cloud Run using Cloud Build
Build and deploy containers with Cloud Build and Artifact Registry | Google Cloud Tech
Getting Started With Cloud Build | Google Cloud Tech

tree.name: Operations, Security, Compliance, and Cost Management
tree.description: Ensure enterprise operational excellence: full-stack Google Cloud Operations suite, zero-trust security perimeter, and FinOps cost governance.

resources.title: Mastering Cloud Monitoring & Logging for GCP | Google Cloud Logging Tutorial
GCP Security Best Practices for Cloud Engineers

children.name: Cloud Operations Suite (Monitoring, Logging, Alerting)
children.description: Master observability with Google Cloud Operations Suite: Cloud Monitoring (dashboards, alert policies, MQL and PromQL querying, uptime checks), Cloud Logging (Log Router sinks to BigQuery/Storage, log-based metrics, exclusion filters), and distributed tracing with Cloud Trace.

resources.title: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Associate Cloud Engineer Certification Course

children.name: Troubleshooting, Debugging, and Incident Response
children.description: Troubleshoot complex cloud incidents: analyzing VPC Flow Logs in BigQuery, debugging serial console outputs, Network Intelligence Center Connectivity Tests for firewall and routing verification, and conducting incident root cause analysis.

resources.title: What is Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)? – Learn SRE Basics
Google Cloud Logging Tutorial for Beginners | Getting Started with Stackdriver Logging

children.name: Advanced Security, Compliance, and Data Protection
children.description: Implement enterprise cloud security: Cloud Key Management Service (Cloud KMS with CMEK and Cloud HSM), Secret Manager for sensitive configuration, Cloud Armor for DDoS and WAF protection, VPC Service Controls to prevent data exfiltration, and Security Command Center (SCC) for posture management.

resources.title: GCP Cloud Security Overview - Top 10 Things You Need To Know

children.name: Cost Management and Optimization Strategies
children.description: Master FinOps cost optimization: Cloud Billing reports, export billing data to BigQuery for SQL analysis, creating budget threshold alerts with Pub/Sub, Recommender API recommendations for rightsizing VMs, and Committed Use Discounts (CUDs).

resources.title: Cloud Cost Management with FinOps - Full Course for Beginners

children.name: Automation and DevOps Practices on GCP
children.description: Automate operational workflows: event-driven automation with Eventarc and Cloud Pub/Sub, Cloud Scheduler for cron jobs, and continuous compliance monitoring with Cloud Asset Inventory.

resources.title: GCP CI/CD Pipeline using Cloud Build and Cloud Deploy | Google Cloud DevOps Tutorial
Cloud Workflows: The Best of Your Google Cloud Services

children.description: Excel in Google Cloud technical interviews: whiteboard cloud architecture (scalability, security, resilience, cost), scenario-based troubleshooting of broken cloud deployments, and articulating trade-offs between Cloud Run, GKE, and Compute Engine.
